_meta.description: Lane Cove archetype-grounded life-history templates. Each archetype has 5-8 first-person life events that LLM uses as anchors when generating per-protag life_history (rather than free-form invention). Events reference real Lane Cove places, schools, council moments, neighborhood patterns. LLM varies templates with agent-specific name/age/details.
_meta.compiled_by: B2 (soul-memory-relations-completeness change); pragmatic first-pass — not yet deep web-researched per-archetype
_meta.usage_notes: _generate_life_history_for_one reads the archetype_id from the matched archetype; samples N=5 events from this archetype's pool; passes them as 'life_event_anchors' to the LLM prompt. LLM then expands with concrete year/place/name details.
